title: At a Glance
description: Site-wide counts — published posts, published pages, pending comments, registered users.

documentation.purpose: Mirrors wp-admin's "At a Glance" box — aggregate, site-wide counts. Counts are intentionally NOT author-scoped (only Recent Drafts is, per issue #133's design note).

reads.purpose: Published-post count via totalItems (per_page: 1, _fields: id). Default view context so the read cap floor (read-only users) sees real counts.
Published-page count via totalItems. Default view context for read-only users.
Pending-comment count via totalItems (status: hold). Needs moderate_comments; read-only users see — here.

states.when: a query is on its initial load (isResolving && totalItems === undefined)
states.renders: Spinner in the affected stat slot — not shown on background refetches that still hold a value.
Four labelled counts (posts / pages / comments / users).
